bugs.name: Ticking a label in the sidebar Labels picker is only saved when the picker closes
bugs.summary: The row shows a ✓ but no request is sent at that moment; after a reload the sidebar lists only \"documentation\" and \"enhancement\" — agent8-normal was never assigned and no timeline entry exists. A request to /eval/harbor-handbook/issues/labels is only sent when the tester clicks somewhere else on the page afterwards (clicking the page background then saved it), so ticking a label and leaving/reloading the page silently loses the assignment. Seen 5 times of 5 (documentation twice, enhancement once, agent8-normal twice). (on /eval/harbor-handbook/pulls/5)
bugs.expected: Clicking a label in the picker assigns it: the label chip appears in the Labels sidebar box, a timeline entry \"eval added the agent8-normal label\" is written, and it is still there after a reload.
bugs.actual: The row shows a ✓ but no request is sent at that moment; after a reload the sidebar lists only \"documentation\" and \"enhancement\" — agent8-normal was never assigned and no timeline entry exists. A request to /eval/harbor-handbook/issues/labels is only sent when the tester clicks somewhere else on the page afterwards (clicking the page background then saved it), so ticking a label and leaving/reloading the page silently loses the assignment. Seen 5 times of 5 (documentation twice, enhancement once, agent8-normal twice).
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-iat14q7nt2yjqq6nojtsc.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/pulls/5 (my own PR "agent7 labels test: release captain docs"; the same happens on any issue/PR sidebar).
In the right sidebar click the "Labels" dropdown to open the label picker.
Type agent8-normal into the "Filter Label" box so only that label is listed.
Click the agent8-normal row once: a ✓ appears next to it and the row is ticked.
Look at the Labels box in the right sidebar and at the Timeline.
bugs.reason: Deliberate design: Gitea documents that the multi-select sidebar combo "defers the update until the dropdown is hidden", and the code only calls doUpdate() in onHide for selection-mode=multiple. Reloading with the picker still open discards an uncommitted selection, which is the documented behaviour, not a lost save.

bugs.name: "Exclusive" checkbox cannot be ticked in the New/Edit Label dialog
bugs.summary: The Exclusive checkbox never ticks: clicking exactly on its square, clicking its "Exclusive" text, and focusing it and pressing Space all leave it an empty square, and after Save + reopening Edit it is still unticked. In the same Edit Label dialog, a click of the same kind on the "Archive Label" checkbox right below it ticks immediately (blue checkmark), so the two checkboxes behave differently. Browser hit-testing on the Exclusive control reports the surrounding form intercepts the click, while the Archive one resolves to its input. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/labels)
bugs.expected: Clicking the Exclusive checkbox (or its label) ticks it, and Save stores the exclusive state so it is still ticked when the label is opened again — as happens with the "Archive Label" checkbox in the same dialog.
bugs.actual: The Exclusive checkbox never ticks: clicking exactly on its square, clicking its "Exclusive" text, and focusing it and pressing Space all leave it an empty square, and after Save + reopening Edit it is still unticked. In the same Edit Label dialog, a click of the same kind on the "Archive Label" checkbox right below it ticks immediately (blue checkmark), so the two checkboxes behave differently. Browser hit-testing on the Exclusive control reports the surrounding form intercepts the click, while the Archive one resolves to its input.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-iat14q7nt2yjqq6nojtsc.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/labels
Click "New Label", type a name into Name and a colour such as #cc00aa into Color
Click the small square checkbox left of the word "Exclusive": nothing changes (two attempts, including a click on the "Exclusive" text)
Click "Save": the label is created with Exclusive off
Click "Edit" on that label (agent1-dblclick) and click the Exclusive checkbox again, then click "Save" and click "Edit" again: Exclusive is still unticked
In the same Edit dialog click the "Archive Label" checkbox just below: it ticks at once (blue checkmark)
bugs.reason: Deliberate: the checkbox is disabled (and force-unchecked) unless the label name has a scope, i.e. contains "/"; the names used (agent1-dblclick, repro-exclusive-j15) have none. The dialog says so right under the checkbox ("Name the label scope/item to make it mutually exclusive...") and the screenshot shows the control greyed out.

bugs.name: "Least issues" label sort orders by total issues while the row shows only open issues
bugs.summary: The list is not in ascending order of the numbers shown: the tail reads agent14-tablet-label "1 open issues/pull requests", documentation "2 open issues/pull requests", then agent7-count "1 open issues/pull requests", then enhancement. The label with 1 open item is listed after the label with 2. After removing the label from closed issue #3 (leaving agent7-count with only its 1 open issue), the same sort put agent7-count correctly before documentation, so the order follows a count that includes closed issues, while the number on the page counts only open ones. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/labels?sort=leastissues&state=)
bugs.expected: Under "Least issues" the labels are ordered by the number shown next to them, smallest first, so a label with "1 open issues/pull requests" always comes before a label with "2 open issues/pull requests".
bugs.actual: The list is not in ascending order of the numbers shown: the tail reads agent14-tablet-label "1 open issues/pull requests", documentation "2 open issues/pull requests", then agent7-count "1 open issues/pull requests", then enhancement. The label with 1 open item is listed after the label with 2. After removing the label from closed issue #3 (leaving agent7-count with only its 1 open issue), the same sort put agent7-count correctly before documentation, so the order follows a count that includes closed issues, while the number on the page counts only open ones.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-ihto2i2dj1c31tlfb1unv.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/labels
Create a label named "agent7-count" (a color must be typed in the Color field first, e.g. #00aabb)

Open open issue #2 (https://5503-ihto2i2dj1c31tlfb1unv.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/issues/2), click "Labels" in the right sidebar, pick "agent7-count", then click anywhere outside the picker so it saves
Open closed issue #3 (https://5503-ihto2i2dj1c31tlfb1unv.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/issues/3) and give it the same "agent7-count" label the same way
Go back to the labels page, open the "Sort" menu and choose "Least issues" (or open .../labels?sort=leastissues&state=)
Scroll to the end of the label list and compare the order of the last labels with their counts
bugs.reason: The sort is coded to order by the label's total issue count (num_issues, open + closed), which matches its menu text "Least issues"; the number in each row is a different, explicitly named metric ("N open issues/pull requests" = NumIssues - NumClosedIssues). The list is correctly ordered by what the option names, so no promise of the app is broken, even though the total is not shown on the page.
